gloss: unless it is; if not; otherwise

definitions.gloss: unless it is ~; if it is not ~
definitions.explanation: The conditional of the negative copula (で + なければ), after a noun or na-adjective stem: the condition that must hold, often followed by a negative or a statement of what is impossible.
At the start of a sentence, short for そうでなければ: if things are not as just said, the following happens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧でなければ⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: You can't enter unless you're a member.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧でなければ⟦{受|う}け{取|と}れません→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: Only the person themselves can collect it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧でなければ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this job is difficult for anyone without experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧。でなければ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Hurry up. Otherwise you'll be late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。でなければ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなる。
examples.english: You'd better book early, or there won't be any seats left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧し⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。でなければ、⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}せません→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Practice a little every day. Otherwise you won't be able to show what you can do on the day.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]でなければ〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unless it is ~, (it) cannot ~
- [noun]でなければ⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: it must be ~
- でなければ、〜 (sentence-initial): otherwise ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- じゃなければ: the casual spoken form
- ⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧: very close; ⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧ sounds more like a warning of a bad result
- ⟦さもなければ→さもなければ：30681_samonakereba⟧: formal and written, sentence-initial only

WATCH OUT:
- After a verb the form is 〜⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧ (⟦{行|い}かなければ→行く：00119_iku⟧), not でなければ.
